title: Причастные обороты: Having finished…, Written in…, Feeling tired…

why: Причастные обороты позволяют заменить целое придаточное коротким оборотом: "Закончив работу, я пошёл домой". В русском это деепричастный оборот, в английском он используется гораздо чаще в письменной речи, отчётах и рассказах. Он делает текст компактным и более взрослым.
formation: • V-ing — действие идёт одновременно или объясняет причину: Feeling tired, I went to bed.
• Having + V3 (третья форма глагола) — действие было раньше главного: Having finished the report, I went home.
• V3 — пассивное значение: Written in Python, the app is fast.
• Being + V3 / Having been + V3 — пассив подчёркнуто: Having been warned, he was careful.
• Отрицание: Not + причастие: Not knowing the answer, he stayed silent.
Главное правило: подлежащее оборота совпадает с подлежащим главного предложения.
usage: 1. Одновременные действия. (Идя на работу, я встретил Анну. — Walking to work, I met Anna.)
2. Одно действие раньше другого. (Прочитав письмо, она позвонила клиенту. — Having read the email, she called the client.)
3. Причина. (Не имея билета, он не смог войти. — Not having a ticket, he couldn't get in.)
4. Пассив: V3 в начале предложения. (Построенный в 1900 году, мост до сих пор используется. — Built in 1900, the bridge is still in use.)

5. После существительного вместо who / which: V-ing для активного, V3 для пассивного значения. (Человек, стоящий у двери, мой босс. — The man standing near the door is my boss. / Файлы, сохранённые вчера, пропали. — The files saved yesterday are gone.)
signalWords: After / before / while / when / since + V-ing: Before leaving, check the lights. While working, I listen to music. Запятая после оборота в начале предложения.
mistakes: ✗ Walking down the street, a car hit me → ✓ Walking down the street, I was hit by a car (подлежащее должно совпадать)
✗ Finished the work, I went home → ✓ Having finished the work, I went home (нужна форма Having + V3 для действия раньше)
✗ Knowing not the answer → ✓ Not knowing the answer (not стоит перед причастием)
✗ Wrote in Java, the program is slow → ✓ Written in Java, the program is slow (пассив требует V3)
✗ Having seen the film, so I didn't go again → ✓ Having seen the film, I didn't go again (союз so не нужен)
remember: Действие "раньше" — Having + V3; действие "с ним" — V-ing; "над ним что-то сделали" — V3; и подлежащее у них общее.

exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в нужную форму причастия

items.prompt: ___ (walk) to work, I met my old teacher.
items.answer: Walking

items.prompt: ___ (finish) the report, she went home.
items.answer: Having finished

items.prompt: ___ (not / know) the answer, he stayed silent.
items.answer: Not knowing

items.prompt: ___ (live) in London for years, he speaks perfect English.
items.answer: Having lived

items.prompt: ___ (write) in Python, the script runs on any system.
items.answer: Written

items.prompt: ___ (feel) tired, I went to bed early.
items.answer: Feeling

items.prompt: ___ (build) in 1890, the bridge is still in use.
items.answer: Built

items.prompt: ___ (not / receive) any reply, we wrote again.
items.answer: Not having received

items.prompt: (a) Open (b) Opening (c) Opened the door, he saw a strange box.
items.answer: (b) Opening

items.prompt: (a) Having eaten (b) Eaten dinner, we watched a movie.
items.answer: (a) Having eaten

items.prompt: ___ by a famous designer, the logo is easy to recognize. (a) Designing (b) Designed
items.answer: (b) Designed

items.prompt: (a) Not feeling (b) Feeling not well, she stayed home.
items.answer: (a) Not feeling

items.prompt: ___ from the top of the hill, the city looks tiny. (a) Seeing (b) Seen
items.answer: (b) Seen

items.prompt: (a) Having lost (b) Losing my keys, I couldn't get into the house.
items.answer: (a) Having lost

items.prompt: After ___ for an hour, we took a taxi. (a) wait (b) waiting
items.answer: (b) waiting

items.prompt: The people (a) living (b) lived (c) lives next door are very noisy.
items.answer: (a) living

items.prompt: As I was walking home, I saw an accident.
items.answer: Walking home, I saw an accident.

items.prompt: After she had read the email, she called the client.
items.answer: Having read the email, she called the client.

items.prompt: Because he didn't have a ticket, he couldn't enter.
items.answer: Not having a ticket, he couldn't enter.

items.prompt: The app was developed by a small team, and it became a hit.
items.answer: Developed by a small team, the app became a hit.

items.prompt: Because I felt nervous, I drank some water.
items.answer: Feeling nervous, I drank some water.

items.prompt: After he had finished his degree, he moved to Berlin.
items.answer: Having finished his degree, he moved to Berlin.

items.prompt: Because it was built with cheap materials, the house fell apart.
items.answer: Built with cheap materials, the house fell apart.

items.prompt: While I was waiting for the train, I read the news.
items.answer: Waiting for the train, I read the news. / While waiting for the train, I read the news.

exercises.instruction: Найдите ошибку и перепишите предложение правильно

items.prompt: Walking down the street, a car almost hit me.
items.answer: Walking down the street, I was almost hit by a car.

items.prompt: Finished the work, I went home.
items.answer: Having finished the work, I went home.

items.prompt: Knowing not the answer, he asked me.
items.answer: Not knowing the answer, he asked me.

items.prompt: Wrote in Java, the program is slow.
items.answer: Written in Java, the program is slow.

items.prompt: Having tired, she went to bed.
items.answer: Feeling tired, she went to bed. / Being tired, she went to bed.

items.prompt: The man stand near the door is my boss.
items.answer: The man standing near the door is my boss.

items.prompt: Having seen the film twice, so I didn't want to go again.
items.answer: Having seen the film twice, I didn't want to go again.

items.prompt: Open the box, she found a letter.
items.answer: Opening the box, she found a letter.

items.prompt: Закончив работу, я пошёл домой.
items.answer: Having finished work, I went home. / Having finished my work, I went home.

items.prompt: Не зная дороги, мы взяли такси.
items.answer: Not knowing the way, we took a taxi.

items.prompt: Идя по улице, я встретил старого друга.
items.answer: Walking down the street, I met an old friend.

items.prompt: Написанное на Python, приложение работает быстро.
items.answer: Written in Python, the app runs fast. / Written in Python, the app works fast.

items.prompt: Чувствуя усталость, он рано лёг спать.
items.answer: Feeling tired, he went to bed early.

items.prompt: Человек, стоящий у двери, — наш новый менеджер.
items.answer: The man standing near the door is our new manager. / The man standing by the door is our new manager.

items.prompt: Прочитав письмо, она сразу ответила.
items.answer: Having read the email, she replied immediately. / Having read the email, she answered right away.

items.prompt: Построенный в 1900 году, этот мост до сих пор используется.
items.answer: Built in 1900, this bridge is still used. / Built in 1900, this bridge is still in use.
